pos.personaBrief: Ceni's Flamengo kept about 60.66% possession (Goal numbers) and pressed high to win the ball in the attacking half, so the team is ball-dominant, not a counter side.

pro.personaBrief: The team wanted quality build-up from the back (Drible de Corpo) with full-backs dropping as third defender, yet recoveries high up produced quick clear shots (Goal debut).

est.personaBrief: Defined phases (back three with ball, line of four without) with a midfielder or full-back dropping, while Gabigol and Bruno Henrique moved, combined through the middle and drifted wide.

lar.personaBrief: Two central creators (Arrascaeta, Everton Ribeiro) behind Gabigol and Gerson/Diego in midfield, with width supplied by Isla and Bruno Henrique acting like wing-backs.

blo.personaBrief: Debut showed Jorge Jesus pillars: marking the opponent's build-up and winning many balls in the attacking field; the defence was a line of four without the ball but high.

mar.personaBrief: No marking evidence in period; Ceni later cited a 'falha de marcação' on a corner. Modern Brazilian zonal tendencies and a space-based back line lean zonal.

pla.personaBrief: Ceni was described as flexible, with emergency plans and offensive or defensive variants, switching to a back three against Palmeiras; but he arrived imposing Jorge Jesus concepts.

res.personaBrief: Pragmatic: he sacrificed Pedro/Gabigol pairing for defensive recomposition and focused on title clinching; a big club that plays to win.

sis.personaBrief: Ceni said he could not pair Pedro and Gabigol because they do not mark, and benched them; collective defensive duty over stars' freedom.

jog.personaBrief: Technical squad (Arrascaeta, Everton Ribeiro, Gerson, Diego) and emphasis on quality of exit from defence, with a ball-playing midfield.

bas.personaBrief: Best squad in Brazil built on experienced stars; Ceni did back Muniz (a returning academy-type player) but title run relied on veterans.

lid.personaBrief: Players wanted his hiring, but he made choices the board disliked and benched stars, acting as the boss with equal rules.
